profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | TypeScript platforms, developer tools, and agent-directed products
profile.summary:
TypeScript platforms, developer tools, and agent-directed products. I’m a software engineer who cares about how the web feels and how it works beneath the surface. My background is in building product interfaces and the systems behind them; more recently, I’ve focused on frameworks and developer tools that I can carry forward into new work. I enjoy taking unfamiliar technical ideas apart and turning them into working software, with attention to interaction, performance, and the details that make it useful.
SELECTED HIGHLIGHTS
• Federato: Took end-to-end ownership of the frontend and, within about three months, rebuilt its foundations while delivering the underwriting workbench that closed the company’s first major contract. Earned two bonuses for client deliveries that led to signed contracts, and two raises.
• PayPal: Shipped passwordless onboarding, raising signup conversion by 50%. Brought Buy Now Pay Later into the Guest and Signup app.
• UT Health: Owned architecture, implementation, and support end to end for a patient-management and surgery-scheduling application used by clinical teams; integrated Epic, Microsoft Graph, and Qgenda APIs.
INDEPENDENT SOFTWARE FACTORY · 2026–PRESENT
Building frameworks and developer tools that carry capabilities from one project into the next. Ergonomics are a core design principle; coding agents are both the builders and the users of these systems. I orchestrate the agents and steer how the frameworks evolve: grounding designs in existing research and formalizations, keeping the systems and their APIs coherent and ergonomic, enforcing the boundaries between them, and holding all implementation to a real standard of correctness.
Type Atlas · Infinite Canvas · Cmd Mesh · WebGPU Engine · coretime · Hyphened · Gitdrops · Package Management
Portfolio: https://tyler.featuretype.com
GitHub: https://github.com/tyler-mitchell

positions.title: Founding and Lead Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Founding engineer at an early-stage insurtech startup building underwriting software. Took end-to-end ownership of the frontend and, within about three months, rebuilt its foundations while delivering the underwriting workbench that closed the company’s first major contract.
• Set technical direction for a Turborepo monorepo that unified previously standalone frontend apps; owned frontend standards and developer experience, and mentored engineers.
• Migrated the core from vanilla JavaScript to TypeScript and added end-to-end API type safety through GraphQL codegen over schemas stitched from separate services.
• Replaced a monolithic query that kept the app loading for over two minutes with a fragment-based data layer.
• Replaced a brittle SASS / Carbon styling layer with Tailwind and a custom headless component library on Radix UI and React Aria.
• Built a feature-flag system for the company’s multi-tenant configuration and release control.
• Earned two bonuses for client deliveries that led to signed contracts, and two raises.

React · TypeScript · GraphQL · Prisma · Express

React · Redux · GraphQL · TypeScript · Node.js

Firebase · React · Mapbox
